text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle☆
Magic of the moon, gather in my legs!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, perrrfect♪
At this rate, the Shuka Sho will be a total breeze!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd find the "magic of racing" right away, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Are you really that relaxed?)

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'll win...! Me, me, ME!!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor A
text_block_list.text:
LIKE・I'D・LET・YOOOOUUUU!!
HAAAAAHHHHHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor B
text_block_list.text:
I won't give it up!!
Under nooooo circumstances will I yield!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...That's not right.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that can't be it!
The Shuka Sho is going to be a much more intense race!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then I should also—

When I headed to the training track,
Sweep Tosho was waiting for me, standing with her hands on her hips.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Too luuuuukewaaaarm!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, what is the meaning of this!
What's with this week's menu!?
choice_data_list: But it's the same training as usual...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, no, no, no!
Not good at aaall!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Familiar, behold!
This is the special magic we need right now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
'1. Magic to become faster than anyone else!
Run while bathing in the power of the midday sun and the sunset!
Keep it up thoroughly for a whole week!'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Spell #2: Magic for ultimate concentration!
Watch tons of races by past Umamusume
and make their magical power my own!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And, and then—!

Sweep Tosho continues explaining
the "Special Magic" written in her notebook.

If every single one of these is treated as training,
it looks like the routine will take up her entire day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You know what, I'm gonna do every single one of these special magic spells!

In that case, it looks like a full two weeks of being
totally immersed in training. Even with rest days,
it feels like we won't have time for anything else...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you get it, hurry up and get ready.
That's your job as my familiar, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely pull off this magic spell!
And then I'll take 1st place in the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving this up to anyone!
Because this is my "racing magic"!
Her eyes held a resolute determination.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

To bring the special magic written in her notebook to life,
it looks like days filled with nothing but training will continue for a while.
—However, all the more reason to believe she will show us an amazing run at the Shuka Sho.
